summary: This informational memo gives application-specific requirements for the Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) when used in Wavelength Switched Optical Networks. Lightpath provisioning needs Routing and Wavelength Assignment, and this lists what PCEP must support for it.

eli5.summary: Planning light paths through fiber means picking routes and colors together. This note lists what the route-planning conversation must be able to say to do that.
